div.div: 4 أَسْحَبْتُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ وَ الشَّرَابِ (tropical:) I took, or ate and drank, much of the food and beverage; as also ↓ تَسَحَّبْتُ : because it is the habit of the glutton to draw and appropriate to himself the victuals [and beverages]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
